# Does the conclusion survive?

One logistic regression on 30,000 rows of real UCI credit-default data, fit on each source and compared to the real fit coefficient by coefficient.

Real coefficients (the conclusion to preserve):

| coefficient | &theta;_real | 95% CI |
|---|---|---|
| `pay_delay_1` | +0.7141 | [+0.6850, +0.7432] |
| `utilization` | -0.3693 | [-0.4489, -0.2897] |
| `log_limit` | -0.3145 | [-0.3476, -0.2814] |
| `age` | +0.0100 | [+0.0069, +0.0131] |

**1 of 7 sources certified.** The one that did is a resample of the real data, which is the positive control and not synthetic at all.
